subject.name: 200 People Worker — Find Person
subject.description: Monthly dumb worker that fills empty CEO/CFO/HR slots in slot_workbench with person names via a three-gate chain: (A) recon data from Process 300, (B) Hunter candidate promotion, (C) Startpage search via DataImpulse proxy. Free before cheap. Always. Fills NAME + TITLE only — email is Process 201's job.
